data.name: Hooded Champion's Initiative
data.description: While the hooded champion has at least 1 panache point, he gains a +2 bonus on initiative checks. In addition, if he has the Quick Draw feat, his hands are free and unrestrained, and his weapon isn't hidden, he can draw a single bow as part of the initiative check.

raw_tokens.value: Hooded Champion Class Feature.Ranger Class Feature.SpecialQuality.Extraordinary

While the hooded champion has at least 1 panache point, he gains a +2 bonus on initiative checks. In addition, if he has the Quick Draw feat, his hands are free and unrestrained, and his weapon isn't hidden, he can draw a single bow as part of the initiative check.
